IDLE.description: Standing still on a window top edge or the desktop floor. Moves along with the window if the window is dragged.

transitions.description: After random idle duration (if wandering is enabled), start walking left or right.
If the underlying window closes, or if dragging the window pushes the character outside the screen/window bounds, detach and enter free-fall (FALL).
When clicked, immediately start crying. If mouse stays pressed beyond holdThresholdSeconds or drags, transitions to DRAGGED_STRUGGLE.

WALK.description: Walking horizontally along the current platform while also detecting small ledges to jump up or window side edges to climb.

transitions.description: When a platform ahead is higher by up to ~0.55x character height, hop up onto that platform.
When encountering the left or right vertical edge of a taller window, grab the edge and start climbing up toward its top surface.
After random walk duration, pause and return to IDLE.
At platform edge: reverse direction (1 - edgeDropProbability) or step off into FALL (edgeDropProbability, if not on floor).
If the underlying window closes or moves so the character exceeds screen/window bounds, enter free-fall.
When clicked, immediately start crying.

JUMP_STEP.description: Hopping along a parabolic arc onto a nearby platform that is up to half a character-height higher.

transitions.description: Land smoothly on the target upper ledge and continue walking.
If the target platform disappears or moves out of bounds mid-jump, enter free-fall.
Grabbed in mid-air during jump.

CLIMB_WALL.description: Climbing vertically up the left or right edge of an application window toward its top edge.

transitions.description: When climbing a tall window and the distance climbed exceeds climbRestSegmentDistanceRatio * characterHeight, pause to rest.
Upon reaching the top edge of the window, step onto the top surface and walk.
If the window closes or moves so the character exceeds screen bounds, let go and enter free-fall.
Pulled off the window wall by the mouse cursor.

CLIMB_REST.description: Clinging to the side edge of a tall window midway up, catching breath with sweat drops before resuming the climb.

transitions.description: After climbRestDurationSeconds, resume climbing up toward the top of the window.
If the window disappears or moves out of screen bounds while resting, enter free-fall.
Pulled off the wall by the mouse.

CRY_CLICK.description: Triggered immediately on mouse click. Character stops and cries with tears while riding the window if on one.

transitions.description: If mouse button is held longer than holdThresholdSeconds (0.18s) or dragged, transition to struggling in mid-air.
If mouse was released quickly (a single click), finish crying after clickCryDurationSeconds and resume IDLE.
If not held by mouse and platform disappears or pushes character out of screen bounds, fall.

DRAGGED_STRUGGLE.description: Mouse button is held down. Character is lifted by the cursor, crying and flailing its arms/legs.

transitions.description: When mouse button is released, drop from current cursor position and fall.

FALL.description: Normal falling under gravity (e.g., walked off a window edge, window closed, or ejected when window moved near screen edge).

transitions.description: Upon landing on a window top or floor (where the character fits within screen bounds), play tumble/fall-over motion.
Can be caught in mid-air by clicking and holding.

FALL_FROM_GRAB.description: Falling after being held/dragged and released by the user.

transitions.description: When hitting a window top edge or the desktop floor, play the falling-over (tumble) animation at that spot.
Can be grabbed again in mid-air.

TUMBLE.description: Landing impact / falling-over motion after dropping onto a surface. After recovering, resumes activity at the landed location.

transitions.description: After tumbleDurationSeconds, stand back up at the landed position and transition to IDLE (then WALK).
If the window disappears or pushes character out of screen bounds while tumbling, fall again.
Clicked while tumbling.
